subject: Supplier account coding & spend-bucket adjustments — PO issuance tracking
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: procurement@zephyrsys.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier account coding & initial spend-bucket setup — Zephyr Systems

Hi Linda / Zephyr procurement,

Welcome — we're excited to get Zephyr Systems set up as a Redwood supplier. To avoid delays in PO issuance, can you confirm the following today:

- Completed onboarding form (see attached template we use internally) — prefer PDF.
- Official remit-to name and billing address for invoices.
- Primary contact for PO questions and a ProcOps email address.
- Any required fields for your invoicing system (tax id, SAP vendor code, etc.).

On our side we'll need to allocate spend across two buckets: "Prod Consumption" (acct code 4510) and "Pilot Credits" (acct code 4520). Typical ask is to have a single PO that contains two line items representing those buckets, with spend caps per item.

Proposed provisional flow:
- Redwood issues a provisional PO number (for onboarding) with spend caps set to the trial amount.
- Once product SKUs are confirmed we will update line items and issue the final PO.

Can you return the onboarding form and your preferred invoice fields by EOD tomorrow? I attached the onboarding checklist we normally use.

Thanks,

Michael Grant
Head of Procurement Programs
Redwood Inference

[attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (form stub)]

From: Linda Choi <linda.choi@zephyrsys.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@zephyrsys.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier account coding & initial spend-bucket setup — Zephyr Systems

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the clear breakdown. Attached is Zephyr's vendor intake PDF and our standard remittance details.

Questions from our side:
- What format do you want for SKU mapping? (CSV preferred for automated ingestion)
- Will the provisional PO be usable for invoicing while you finalize the SKU lines?
- Any minimum invoice thresholds or split-invoice rules we should know about?

We can return the onboarding form and a CSV SKU list by tomorrow morning. If you issue the provisional PO now it will help us start internal scheduling.

Best,
Linda Choi
Vendor Relations
Zephyr Systems

[attachment: Zephyr_Onboarding_Form.pdf]
[attachment: Zephyr_Remittance_Details.pdf]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Supplier account coding & initial spend-bucket setup — Zephyr Systems

Michael — forwarding Zephyr's form. Two quick notes from procurement:

- They will provide SKU list as CSV (good).
- Our finance team will want the "Prod Consumption" line capped at $125,000 and "Pilot Credits" capped at $25,000 for the first quarter. Please confirm if finance can set those caps on the provisional PO.

Marcus / Finance: if we issue a provisional PO with those caps, can you also add accounting codes and the cost-center split (ENG: 70% acct 4510, GTM trial fund: 30% acct 4520) so AP can route invoices automatically?

Thanks — Neha

Subject: Re: Supplier account coding & initial spend-bucket setup — Zephyr Systems

Thanks — finance reviewed and can issue a provisional PO with spend buckets but we need clarified line-item SKUs to finalize the accounting mapping. Actions:

1) I'm provisionally assigning PO number PO-67821 for Zephyr Systems. This will be marked "provisional" in our system and can be used for scheduling and initial invoicing; final PO will supersede it after SKU reconciliation.

2) Spend caps: Prod Consumption — $125,000 (acct 4510); Pilot Credits — $25,000 (acct 4520). We will allow split invoicing against each line as long as invoices reference the line-item SKU.

3) Please ask Zephyr to send SKU_Mapping_v2.csv with columns: sku, description, unit_price, accounting_bucket (prod|pilot). Once we receive, finance will update the PO line descriptions and lock accounting codes.

Attachments: provisional PO worksheet (contains the assigned number and preliminary line placeholders).

Marcus Lin
Senior Finance Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Linda,

Thanks — confirming Redwood has issued provisional PO PO-67821 (see attached worksheet). Items to close this out:

- Please send SKU_Mapping_v2.csv matching Marcus's template (sku, description, unit_price, accounting_bucket) — we'll accept a CSV attachment or a Google Sheet link.
- Confirm Zephyr will invoice referencing the SKU in the invoice line so AP can route automatically.
- Once finance ingests the SKU file we'll push the final PO and notify you via DocuSign if any SOW addenda require signing.

For clarity, the provisional PO line placeholders are:
- Line 1: Prod Consumption — cap $125,000 — acct 4510 — placeholder SKU(s)
- Line 2: Pilot Credits — cap $25,000 — acct 4520 — placeholder SKU(s)

I've attached our expected SKU template and a copy of the provisional PO. If everything checks out we can accept an initial invoice against the provisional PO next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Michael Grant
Head of Procurement Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments:

- provisional_PO_67821.xlsx (provisional worksheet)
